news_items.headline: SanDisk (SNDK) jumps as Barclays upgrades to overweight, lifts PT to $2,300 on $42B in contracts
news_items.summary: Barclays analyst Thomas O'Malley upgraded SNDK to overweight from equal weight and raised PT to $2,300 from $1,200, citing five-year supply agreements with minimum contractual revenue of roughly $42B.

news_items.headline: SanDisk Stock (SNDK) Soars on 2026 Red Dot Design Awards Win
news_items.summary: SNDK rallied after winning the 2026 Red Dot Design Awards for leadership in consumer storage solutions.

news_items.headline: SanDisk Corporation Stock (SNDK) Moved Up by 5.71% on May 28
news_items.summary: SNDK rose 5.71% on May 28, with the stock continuing to ride momentum from AI-related NAND demand and positive analyst sentiment.

news_items.headline: Sandisk Has Climbed From $36 to $1,590 in a Year. What the AI Memory Boom Means for the Stock
news_items.summary: Feature noting SNDK has climbed >4,000% over the past 12 months on the AI memory boom; piece weighs upside vs. valuation risk after the rally.

news_items.headline: Veteran analyst has blunt message on Sandisk stock after massive rally
news_items.summary: Commentary on SNDK following its massive rally; flags caution on valuation after the run-up while acknowledging the AI-driven demand backdrop.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Barclays upgraded to overweight, PT $2,300 from $1,200 (~2026-05-27). Mizuho raised PT to $1,825 from $1,625, Outperform. Citi raised PT to $2,025 from $1,300, Buy (2026-05-19). High estimate $2,350, low $1,000 across 22 analysts.

earnings_context.notes: Q3 FY2026 (reported Apr 30, 2026) was the major catalyst: revenue $5.95B (+251% YoY), beat guidance by $1.15B, non-GAAP EPS $23.41 vs $12-14 guide, plus $6B buyback. Street watches QLC Stargate SSD revenue ramp this fiscal Q4 and the $42B multi-year contract backlog. Next report estimated Aug 13, 2026 (no near-term earnings catalyst within trade horizon).
